dependencies.name: hnswlib
dependencies.spec: >=0.8.0 (optional extra 'ann', NOT installed by the default sync)
dependencies.evidence: HYDRA/models/HNSW_index.py:4-8 tries 'import hnswlib' behind try/except and :33-38 resolves ann_backend='auto' to hnswlib when importable, otherwise to scikit-learn. hnswlib is absent from upstream/requirements.txt (it is only mentioned in README.md as a conda-forge fallback: 'conda install -c conda-forge hnswlib'), so the default sync installs the scikit-learn backend — the same behaviour as the documented 'pip install -r requirements.txt'. Not pinning it avoids a source build (hg+setuptools C++ compile) that would make the lock environment-dependent; `uv sync --extra ann` enables it when a toolchain is available.
dependencies.compatibility_adjustment: hybrid: optional extra instead of a hard dependency, because the official requirements.txt does not list it and the code degrades gracefully.

compatibility_adjustments.topic: torch is listed in the official requirements but is not needed by the HYDRA detector
compatibility_adjustments.finding: EasyTSAD/Methods/HYDRA/upstream/HYDRA/main.py:2-3 imports torch only to seed RNGs (torch.manual_seed / torch.cuda.manual_seed / torch.cuda.manual_seed_all) and to print torch.cuda.is_available(); the HYDRA model modules (HYDRA/HYDRA_loader.py:1-3, HYDRA/models/HYDRA_approx.py:1-3, HYDRA/models/HYDRA_exact.py:1-3, HYDRA/models/HNSW_index.py:1-14) import only numpy, scikit-learn and optionally hnswlib — no torch tensors, no .cuda() dispatch.
compatibility_adjustments.resolution: torch is intentionally NOT declared. main.py is also not usable as-is: it inserts ROOT/TSB-AD on sys.path and imports TSB_AD.* (HYDRA/main.py:7-12), i.e. the vendored benchmark suite (upstream/TSB-AD), so the official entrypoint is the TSB-AD benchmark driver rather than the HYDRA integration surface. EasyTSAD drives the loader directly. Decision recorded here rather than silently dropped.
compatibility_adjustments.impact: none on the enabled algorithm; compute device remains cpu (see reproduction/source.json compatibility.compute_device).

compatibility_adjustments.topic: benchmark-suite dependencies are not HYDRA requirements
compatibility_adjustments.finding: torchinfo, h5py, einops, arch, hurst, tslearn, cython, stumpy, networkx, transformers are the TSB-AD benchmark dependency set (40 detectors + suite utilities; mirrored in upstream/TSB-AD/setup.py). None of them is imported anywhere under upstream/HYDRA/models, upstream/HYDRA/HYDRA_loader.py, or the EasyTSAD integration path.
compatibility_adjustments.resolution: omitted from [project].dependencies to keep the lock minimal and avoid the tslearn/cython source builds. If the controller later needs to run the official TSB-AD benchmark entrypoint (upstream/HYDRA/main.py), those packages must be added to this project — they are recorded here so that requirement is not lost.
compatibility_adjustments.impact: official benchmark entrypoint (`python -m HYDRA.main`) cannot run in this environment; the HYDRA algorithm path can.

compatibility_adjustments.finding: EasyTSAD's root project only requires numpy>=1.21, so a bare install could resolve NumPy 2.x, which the official pin forbids.
compatibility_adjustments.resolution: explicit 'numpy>=1.24.3,<2.0' in [project].dependencies, matching the repository convention (envs/torch2/pyproject.toml:11 'numpy<2').
compatibility_adjustments.impact: none; NumPy 1.26.x satisfies both EasyTSAD and the official HYDRA pin on Python 3.11.

compatibility_adjustments.finding: Every enabled code path is CPU-only numpy/sklearn computing; the only CUDA-aware calls in the repository are the RNG seeding guards in main.py, which are no-ops without CUDA.
compatibility_adjustments.resolution: no torch/CUDA index ([tool.uv.index] pytorch-cu124) is declared, unlike envs/torch2/pyproject.toml:33-36. The environment installs from PyPI only.
compatibility_adjustments.impact: the environment is portable to CPU-only hosts and needs no NVIDIA driver.

incompatibilities.detail: upstream/HYDRA/main.py:5-12 inserts ROOT/TSB-AD into sys.path and imports TSB_AD.evaluation.metrics, TSB_AD.utils.slidingWindows, TSB_AD.model_wrapper and TSB_AD.HP_list. TSB-AD is a separate repository, vendored here at upstream/TSB-AD but not installed as a distribution.
incompatibilities.mitigation: EasyTSAD integrates HYDRA through HYDRA/HYDRA_loader.py::HYDRA, which has no TSB-AD dependency (HYDRA_loader.py:1-3). If TSB-AD is needed later, install upstream/TSB-AD (its setup.py declares package TSB_AD v1.5) into this environment.

incompatibilities.detail: hnswlib has no binary wheel for all platforms and must compile C++ (HNSW). It is also absent from upstream/requirements.txt, so the official 'pip install -r requirements.txt' path runs without it.
incompatibilities.mitigation: declared as the optional extra 'ann'; default sync resolves the scikit-learn ANN backend (HYDRA/models/HNSW_index.py:33-38). Scores may differ marginally between backends (approximate vs exact kNN).
